programs.title: Spicks and Specks
programs.sub_title: Behani, Tom Cardy, Brian Mannix & Michala Banas
programs.desc: This week there's a lot to dig - Behani teaches Adam, Myf and Alan the Persian Snap, Tom Cardy dances to PSY, Brian Mannix regales with Countdown stories and Michala Banas tries to reach an invisible top shelf.

programs.title: Anh's Brush With Fame
programs.desc: Anh is joined by champion cyclist Anna Meares. From her upbringing as a coal miner's daughter to winning Olympic gold, she opens up about her near-death injury, personal loss, family sacrifice and record-breaking triumph.

programs.title: Grand Designs Australia
programs.desc: In Yarraville, Victoria, a passive house builder starts a crusade to build the healthiest home in Australia on the site of an old pigeon club house! (Final).

programs.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programs.desc: Murdoch teams up with a brilliant French detective to solve the disappearance of a young French woman who recently arrived in Toronto.

programs.title: Long Lost Family
programs.desc: The story of a woman desperate for a second chance with the baby she gave up for adoption nearly fifty years ago, and a sister searching for her brother who mysteriously disappeared forty years ago.

programs.title: Antiques Roadshow
programs.desc: Fiona Bruce and the experts are in Herefordshire at Hampton Court Castle near Leominster. Amongst the family treasures under scrutiny are an important record of the days of early photography and a collection of jade.
